news.title: ASX Runners of the Week: Alvo, Pioneer Minerals & Dalaroo
news.snippet: The Bulls N’ Bears ASX Runner of the Week is... Alvo Minerals, which soared 257% on its promising heavy rare earths grades and a potential game-changing processing route for its Brazilian project.

news.title: Big Hits: Dalaroo leads with stellar West African gold strike
news.snippet: Big Hits looks at notable drill intercepts reported to the ASX this week, led by Dalaroo Metals in Côte d’Ivoire, with runners-up Power Minerals in Brazil and Midas Minerals in Namibia.

news.title: Aurum strikes rich West African gold trifecta ahead of resource lift
news.snippet: Aurum Resources has hit more gold at its 3.22-million-ounce West African Boundiali project, with new results including 29m at 2.08g/t and 5.85m at 8.77g/t gold, ahead of a resource update.

news.title: Dalaroo chases more gold after spectacular Côte d’Ivoire hit
news.snippet: Dalaroo Metals has launched a 1250m drilling blitz at its Bondoukou gold discovery in Côte d’Ivoire, chasing extensions to a spectacular maiden hit of 18m at 7.31g/t gold.

news.title: Kaiser Reef gold production fuels $40M war chest
news.snippet: Gold producer Kaiser Reef has built a $40 million cash and bullion position after a strong September quarter, delivering 6263 gold ounces from its Tasmanian and Victorian assets.

news.title: The world’s richest person is testing Wall Street’s limits
news.snippet: Elon Musk has always been a mixed blessing for Wall Street. Now, as the AI party rolls on, he is testing the limits of the debt boom.

news.title: The Cap Raise Crucible: Big books, broker options and mixed fortunes
news.snippet: Cap Raise Crucible has dissected $700m in ASX raisings, led by L1 Global’s $480m haul, as brokers’ fees and options faced scrutiny and punters pocketed big gains or suffered double-digit losses.

news.title: An old spectre has returned to haunt Europe and things could get ugly
news.snippet: Troubles that started in France threaten to engulf the whole eurozone, and at their heart is a familiar irresponsible attitude that has plagued the continent for decades.
